resources.string: Shows a mic button on text fields. Speech stays on this phone.

Hush shows a small mic button when you edit a text field. Tap the mic and speak. Tap the check mark to put the text at the cursor, or tap X to stop. Hush finds the focused text field and types the text into it. Speech recognition runs on this phone. Hush does not send audio or text to a server.
Private voice typing. Speech recognition runs on this phone. Do the steps below one time.
Hush downloads the model one time. After that, Hush uses no network.
Download stopped: %1$s. Tap Download to continue.
Go to Installed apps > Hush voice typing and turn it on. If Android shows \"Restricted setting\", open app info, tap ⋮ (top right), tap \"Allow restricted settings\", and try again.
In app info, set Battery to Unrestricted. Then go to Settings > Battery > Background usage limits and add Hush to \"Never sleeping apps\".
Tap here. The mic button shows above the keyboard.
Download the speech model in Hush first.
The microphone gave no sound. Another app can use it, or Android blocks it.
Hush cannot use the speech model. Download it again.
Hush cannot type in this field. The text is on the clipboard. Paste it.
